label: F0-部署面现役包核验
expr: (async()=>{const url=[...performance.getEntriesByType('resource')].map(e=>e.name).find(n=>n.includes('/plugins/'));const text=await (await fetch(url)).text();return {url:url.slice(0,110), bytes:text.length, newSlotMain: text.includes('name: "main", key: "conversation"'), oldSlot: text.includes('name: "conversation", id: "dsh-bots-main"'), oldIcons: /primitives\.Icon\w*Outline(16|14)/.test(text), markdownLabels: text.includes('function markdownLabels(t)')};})()

label: F6-native-baseline
expr: (() => { const pick=(el)=>{const s=getComputedStyle(el);return {h:s.height,radius:s.borderRadius,font:s.fontFamily.slice(0,28),size:s.fontSize,color:s.color,bg:s.backgroundColor};}; const q=(sel)=>document.querySelector(sel); const rows=[...document.querySelectorAll('.bhn1Oq_row, [class*=sessionRow]')].filter(e=>e.offsetHeight>0); return {newSession:pick(q('.hHd-Xa_newSession')), settings:pick(q('.VOzbGW_trigger')), sessionRow:pick(rows[0])}; })()

label: F6-bot-styles
expr: (() => { const pick=(el)=>{const s=getComputedStyle(el);return {h:s.height,radius:s.borderRadius,font:s.fontFamily.slice(0,28),size:s.fontSize,color:s.color,bg:s.backgroundColor};}; const q=(sel)=>document.querySelector(sel); const rows=[...document.querySelectorAll('.dsh-bots-list > *')].filter(e=>e.offsetHeight>0); return {newBot:pick(q('.dsh-bots-sidebar-newbot')), iconBtn:pick(q('.dsh-bots-iconbtn')), botRow:pick(rows[0]), tokensCssRules:[...document.styleSheets].flatMap(ss=>{try{return [...ss.cssRules].map(r=>r.cssText)}catch{return[]}}).filter(t=>t.includes('--dsw-')).length}; })()

label: F3-退出
expr: (() => { const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x=>(x.getAttribute('aria-label')||x.title||'').includes('退出 Bot 模式')); if(!b) return {found:false}; b.click(); return {found:true}; })()
